_README: Hand-made corrections applied on top of the scaffold produced by
scripts/extract_registry.py. Each entry records WHAT was changed, WHY,
and against WHICH source it was verified — so the correction is itself
evidence, and so regenerating the scaffold never silently reverts it.
Keyed by ИНН where one exists, otherwise by slug.
'set'          overwrites fields on the matching scaffold record
'add_entities' appends whole records the scaffold could not produce
(e.g. the second company in a compound table row)
'people'       same as 'set' but for people.json, keyed by slug
(personal ИНН/DOB/etc are re-derived from source text
every run, so a plain JSON edit does not survive
re-running extract_registry.py — must go through here)
Once verification is complete the extractor is retired and the registry
is hand-edited directly; this file stays as the change log.

people_add_entities.notes: 46 years old as of the iStories article (2024-01-19). Former Vice-President of pharmaceutical holding «Р-Фарм» (until 2018) -- founder Алексей Репик is known for his aircraft being used by Putin's daughter Екатерина Тихонова; Орджоникидзе served alongside Репик in the leadership of «Деловая Россия» (Business Russia). After Р-Фарм, worked in the Russian operations of tobacco company Philip Morris (per iStories, partial sentence in source). Son of Russian diplomat Григорий Орджоникидзе (executive secretary of Russia's UNESCO commission). Great-grandson of Серго Орджоникидзе, Soviet commissar and close associate of Stalin, who died by suicide amid the purges. Per iStories, one of the two real beneficial owners of ООО «НПО Рустехдрон» -- illustrates the same declared-vs-actual-owner pattern this project tracks elsewhere: the entity's registered GD (Соколов Г.О., see ooo-npo-rustekhdron) is not the beneficial owner named by press investigation.
